top_signals.title: Luxury Spending Drives Running Culture
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Retail Reporter Lily Meier says running has evolved from a fitness activity into a lifestyle and status symbol, with run clubs fueling demand for premium apparel, accessories and social experiences. She says brands are benefiting as consumers increasingly spend on high-end performance gear that blends athletic function with fashion, even as running remains accessible to those who prefer simpler equipment. (Source: Bloomberg)
